removeAds.devBlockedBody: Only a release build can create a real transaction. Nothing has been charged.
removeAds.errorBody: Check your connection and try again. Your tasks and reminders are not affected.
removeAds.loading: Getting the price from the store…
removeAds.nothingFoundBody: The store account on this device has never bought ad removal. If you bought it with another account, sign in to that account in the store and try again.
removeAds.pendingBody: Ads turn off by themselves once the payment completes, even on a later launch. You don't need to buy again.
removeAds.pendingTitle: The store hasn't confirmed your payment yet.
removeAds.pitch: Pay once, keep it forever. After a reinstall or on a new device, restore it with the same store account.
removeAds.restoredBody: Ads are off on this device.
removeAds.successBody: Thank you. Ads are off — no restart needed.
removeAds.successNote: On a new device or after a reinstall, the purchase comes back with the same store account.
removeAds.title: Remove ads
removeAds.unavailableBody: Ad removal isn't available in the store for your region yet. The app works as usual. If you bought it elsewhere, you can restore it.

settings.adsUnavailableTitle: This device can't make in-app purchases.
settings.countdownHint: Applies to every task, including ones with no reminder. From this point the task row shows a countdown ticking every second. It changes nothing about notifications.
settings.dataAds: Ads are provided by Google and use this device's advertising ID. Task names and notes are never sent.
settings.dataOnDevice: Your data is only on this device. Uninstalling the app loses it.

destroyBody.one: This can't be undone. {{count}} task and every reminder it has will be deleted.
destroyBody.other: This can't be undone. {{count}} tasks and every reminder they have will be deleted.

settings.languageHint: A new language applies right away, with no restart. Task names and notes you typed stay exactly as you wrote them.

shift.dateOnlyHere: This is the only place the date can change. Dragging only changes the time within the same day.

timeline.emptyBody: Add a task, or look at another day.

timeline.newTaskSwipeHint: Swipe up to add a task
